translation:
In the conditions of injury with pain of the lower back and pain of the spine, whether from falling from a height or from being struck and beaten, it is caused by stagnant blood remaining in the taiyang (太陽) channel; one should treat it with Earth Dragon Powder (地龍散).
<ins>Earth Dragon Powder (地龍散)</ins>
Earth dragon (地龍), cinnamon bark (官桂), sappan wood (蘇木, each nine fen), ephedra (麻黃, seven fen), phellodendron (黃柏), dang gui tail (當歸尾, each two and a half qian), peach kernel (桃仁, nine), licorice (甘草, three and a half qian)
Above, decoct in water and take before food.
